_ayuda: Lista de imágenes realistas que GitHub genera con Gemini (scripts/sortu_irudiak.py). Solo se generan las que aún no existen en estatico/irudiak-errealak/<id>.jpg. Para rehacer una, borra su .jpg. Describe SOLO el contenido: el estilo (realista, fondo blanco, sin texto) se añade solo.

irudiak.prompt: A young potted plant in the centre receiving what it needs to live: bright sunlight coming from the sun in the upper left, water drops falling from a small watering can on the right, soft air flow lines around the leaves, and rich brown soil in the pot. Each element clearly separated so it can be labeled.

A realistic ancient Egyptian Nile river valley during the annual flood, with the river, fertile fields, irrigation channels, a small wooden boat, and dry desert beyond the green riverbanks, each element clearly separated.
The ancient pyramids of Giza viewed from a respectful distance, with the three stone pyramids, surrounding desert plateau, and a few workers carrying stone blocks in the foreground.
A historically inspired, realistic portrait of a generic ancient Egyptian pharaoh wearing a nemes headdress and holding a crook and flail, with no names, writing, or modern objects.
A close view of ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs carved into a limestone temple wall, showing distinct carved bird, eye, water, and seated-person signs, with no modern writing.

A realistic reconstruction of ordinary ancient Egyptian daily life beside the Nile, with people baking bread, carrying water jars, weaving cloth, and working in a field, with distinct activities and simple mud-brick homes.
